Just wondering what you guys do and what you like most about your position / department.
What position are you in the industry, and what made you pick that position / department?

I work in the Grip and Electric department mostly, I always enjoy that feeling looking at your condor rig flying high and mighty, or all the 9 and 12 lights finally shedding some light on the situation. Not having to go to the gym is a huge plus too.

I have yet to meet many people who only do one thing. I mostly work as a UPM or LP, but I do a lot of AE/Editing also. Different size projects and for different reasons. I do a few music videos a year for newer bands where I direct and edit because of budget constraints. I guess I love to make stories and images live, so that would be why Producing comes more naturally for my specific desire and drive. I have no problem finishing up a rate job and then doing side projects where I lose a few bucks. I would eat ramen everyday and make films. Luckily I don't have to at this time.

As thundar said, I move between departments depending on the project, because sometimes it's nice to hop back behind the camera. But primarily I'm an AD or a producer. I love being in a position to facilitate everything just coming together, and that bliss that occurs when everything operates silky smooth is glorious.

I like spreadsheets.

Camera Department. (Usually OP or AC)

I came from a photography background shooting a lot of bands and then I shot a lot of music videos. As my friends grew up into ad jobs I came along for the ride. Now that I make okay money on small-time TV and Web spot crews I'm looking to move into doing more fun film work.

Typically the Camera department. I got into film making from photography, so that's my primary skill set. Though I do sometimes work in the grip department for the same reason - I understand how light photographs, so I can rough in lights pretty quickly compared to a lot of people.
